name: bulwark
notes: LOOP-2 REDESIGN (changes game code must pick up): walk ground speed is now 1.5 m/s (was 2.2; feet are planted only at this speed: set BULWARK.walkSpeed / read locomotion.walk). Clip lengths changed: spawn 2.2 s, slam 2.65 s, lob 1.8 s, stagger 2.6 s, death 3.0 s; the event times gameplay already uses are unchanged (spawn ignite 0.36, slam windup 0.50 / impact 1.05, lob open 0.36 / release 0.84, stagger open 0.70 / close 1.72). New events: lob 'shut' 1.0, death 'knees_hit' 1.00, 'ground_hit' 1.80, 'plates_loose' 1.90, guard 'wall_up' 0.34 / 'wall_down' 1.30. New extra clip 'guard' (1.8 s, one-shot from/to idle): both tower shields raised together in front as a wall. Every clip carries meta 'glow' curves for core/seam/fist/vent_glow (death gutters every glow to 0, spawn ignites from 0); if game code also sets glow k by hand it will fight them. Bone names are unchanged; added piston_waist_a/b_l/r. socket_core is at the furnace mouth (the arched door), socket_head in front of the eye slit, socket_attack_* at the knuckle faces, socket_vent_* above the chimney caps. Faces +Z, origin between the feet, metres, 60 fps sampled clips, loops first == last frame. walk is in place at 1.5 m/s (locomotion.walk). hit is idle-frame-0 + upper-body deltas with the lower body exactly at idle frame 0: play it additively via THREE.AnimationUtils.makeClipAdditive(hitClip, 0). All one-shots (slam, lob, hit, stagger, guard, spawn end) start/end on idle frame 0. Glow materials: core_glow (the firebox interior: bed, back wall, coals, door peep holes), seam_glow (molten core seen through plate gaps and the brick-arch joints, crack splits, eye slit, slag), fist_glow (forearm core and knuckles), vent_glow (chimney flues and the firebox throat). Their emissive maps are heat masks: luminance rises monotonically with heat (white = hottest), colour dull red -> #ff5a1f -> #fff1c9. Authored emissive strengths: core 22, seam 10, fist 10, vent 14. Detachable plates (separate mesh islands skinned 100% to one leaf bone, nothing else on that bone): plate_shoulder_l, plate_shoulder_r, shield_l, shield_r, shutter_top, shutter_bot, shutter_l, shutter_r, tasset_l, tasset_r, vent_l, vent_r. Cracks and iron straps on those plates ride the same bone. To break one off: copy the vertices skinned to that bone into a debris mesh at the bone's world transform, then scale the bone to 0. In death, plate_shoulder_l, shield_r, shutter_l, shutter_top, tasset_l and vent_r work loose on their bones from 'plates_loose' (translation + rotation keys); spawn debris from the bone's current world transform. Weak point: socket_core, exposed during stagger 'open'..'close' and lob 'open'..'release'+0.25 s. death ends lying face-down with the pelvis 0.80 m forward (+0.00 m sideways) of a stationary root (no root motion). Normal maps MikkTSpace (OpenGL +Y), tangents exported. ORM = AO (R), roughness (G), metallic (B); the iron straps/grates/rings are metallic texels inside the ceramic material. Bounds are measured from the mesh (height to the chimney caps; shoulder slabs top out ~2.85 m). Plate bones carry baked spring lag. Every vertex carries a float _plate attribute (one id per part) for the kiln ceramic shader's per-plate value and glaze pick. lob: the doors are fully shut at 'shut' 1.00 (gameplay currently hardcodes 1.09).
